visualCharacteristics.description: Shadowed image-top tiles: image, optional bold title, text, CTA pinned to the bottom; 1-4 column wrapping grid (5 -> 3 cols, 8/12 -> 4 cols). Download CTAs (PDF / 'Download ...') render as centred tiles with a blue button. Options: blue-caption (sky-blue caption panel, white text), unboxed (customer grid, auto when all images linked), logo-list (retailer rows, auto when all CTAs read 'Visit').
visualCharacteristics.purpose: resource downloads, videos and case studies
visualCharacteristics.imagePattern: image on top of each tile

contentPattern.description: 1 row per card: [image (optionally linked: YouTube watch URL / case study / PDF) | optional bold title or name, text, CTA link last]. Append #_dnb to YouTube links so they stay links (otherwise the youtube auto-block embeds them).
contentPattern.structure: 1 row per card: [image | bold title + text + CTA link]
